answer: The nebula of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Work waits on the lantern until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the oasis of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
